author: AetherBox / linuxcontainers.org
name: SteamOS base (Arch) - aarch64
description: Not an official Valve image. SteamOS 3 (Holo) is Arch-based — this is the Arch Linux LXC rootfs for phones/ARM devices. Install Steam/Proton yourself; gaming on Android GPU is limited.

author: AetherBox / linuxcontainers.org
name: SteamOS base (Arch) - x86_64
description: Not an official Valve image. Arch Linux LXC rootfs (SteamOS 3 base) for x86_64 / amd64 hosts. Closer to Steam Deck CPU arch than ARM phones.

author: linuxcontainers.org
name: Arch Linux current - LXC Base
description: Plain Arch Linux LXC rootfs (same upstream as the SteamOS-base entries). Use this if you want stock Arch without the SteamOS label.
